title: What the Foundation Held
text: The building you painted over has stopped weeping. It has started breathing. Last night the floor of the cellar opened like a mouth, and there are steps going down that were never built.

options.label: Send a Scion down the steps that were never built.

outcomes.text: They come back up with something in their arms that was buried before the city was founded, and will not say what else they saw.
They come back up a day later, on all fours, and the steps close behind them. They are mostly still themselves.

options.label: Pour the cellar full of lead.

outcomes.text: It takes every scrap of iron in the stores. The breathing stops. The building is never quite level again.
